test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_to_bool_lc (n LowCardinality(UInt64), s LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO test_to_bool_lc SELECT number % 2, number % 2 ? 'true' : 'false' FROM numbers(20000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(toBool(n)) FROM test_to_bool_lc SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT sum(toBool(s)) FROM test_to_bool_lc SETTINGS max_threads = 1
